mentions.name: fallout2-ce
mentions.description: A modern game engine that can play the Classic Fallout 1/2 games on modern systems, including mac, linux, iOS, and Android, aiming to bring these games to a wider audience.
mentions.problem: Classic Fallout 1/2 games cannot be played on modern systems, including mac, linux, iOS, and Android.
mentions.audience: Wider audience of players who want to play the classic Fallout 1/2 games on mac, linux, iOS, and Android
mentions.source_excerpt:
A modern game engine that can play the Classic Fallout 1/2 games on modern systems (including mac, linux, iOS, Android).  Hoping to bring these games to a wider audience.

https://github.com/fallout2-ce/fallout2-ce/
mentions.author: mikeklaas
